meta.title: Markdown preview
meta.description: Renders your own messages as Markdown, in the draft and in the transcript. While you type, a card just above the input box shows the message as it will read — lists, numbering, bold, quotes, tables and code blocks instead of raw markers; after sending, your messages show the same way in the conversation. The card appears only once the draft contains Markdown syntax. The MD button in the composer tool row is the master switch: turn it off and the card disappears and your sent messages return to raw text. Parsing happens in the browser only: the model still receives the original Markdown and the session log is unchanged.
